summary: TPG Twin Brook Capital Income Fund, a Delaware statutory trust and non-traded BDC, filed a routine 8-K under Items 7.01 and 8.01 disclosing September 2026 distributions and monthly net asset value. Class I, S and D shares each carry a $0.2000 gross distribution, with shareholder servicing fees of $0.0000, $0.0176 and $0.0052 respectively, payable to holders of record September 30, 2026 and paid on or about October 28, 2026 in cash or via reinvestment. NAV per share was $25.2073 across classes as of August 31, 2026; aggregate NAV $2.8 billion, portfolio fair value $5.3 billion, debt $2.6 billion, 0.94x leverage. No special-situation event; continuous $5.0 billion offering remains ongoing.
